instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: GrowthTrack Analytics is a B2B SaaS provider offering project management and data visualization tools tailored for the construction industry. We focus on optimizing resource allocation through predictive analytics modules integrated into our existing platform.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently launched three incremental updates to its core software suite focused on user experience improvements and minor feature enhancements. A pilot project for a new AI-driven forecasting module is currently underway but not yet scaled.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is aggressive revenue growth by capturing market share within the mid-market construction sector over the next three years. We aim to achieve 40% annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth.
answers.teamSize: The core team consists of 12 dedicated engineers, product managers, and sales specialists focused primarily on execution and stability.
answers.additionalContext: We face competition from established enterprise software providers and emerging niche startups offering specialized AI tools.

opportunities.title: Feature Expansion: Integrated Industry Templates
opportunities.rationale: This involves creating standardized project templates that automate setup for new clients, which addresses internal process bottlenecks and allows us to upsell premium features efficiently. This is a low-risk way to increase perceived value.

first_actions: Identify top 5 high-value client use cases
Define template structure and required data fields
Build MVP of the automation tool
execution_plan.success_metric: 50% increase in demo conversion rate for new leads within 6 months
milestones: Beta testing with 2 pilot clients: Month 5

opportunities.title: Customer Success Program Optimization
opportunities.rationale: By formalizing a proactive Customer Success (CS) program focused on retention and upsells, we can improve customer lifetime value (CLV), which is crucial for sustained growth. This leverages existing customer relationships.

first_actions: Conduct NPS deep dive to identify churn indicators
Train the support team on proactive engagement tactics
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce churn rate by 10% over the next fiscal year
milestones: Q3 CLV increase target: End of Q4

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance AI Module (V2)
opportunities.rationale: Developing a truly predictive AI module that forecasts equipment failure for construction sites moves us from optimization to prediction, creating a significant competitive moat. This aligns directly with our growth priority and market need.

resources_needed: Hiring budget for 1 senior AI engineer (Year 2)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 15% reduction in client downtime reported by users
milestones: Proof of concept model trained: Month 8
API integration with core platform: Month 12

next_steps.action: Schedule a formal review of the Customer Success playbook to identify immediate retention gaps.
Finalize resource allocation and project roadmap for the V2 Predictive AI module, securing initial data science contracts.
Launch an internal cross-departmental workshop to redefine core product templates and standardize feature requests.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on a single core engineering team, creating high burnout risk.
Slow internal process for scaling development from pilot to enterprise level.
Limited direct control over long-term strategic technological shifts due to conservative appetite.
Inconsistent customer data quality across different project types.
